title: GP / Novice / Jack Cup / Mute City / Blue Falcon — grid to green light
notes: In-race frames are the ones the 3DS viewport fold CANNOT affect: the fold only fires on
race_grid and race_start are directly comparable while race_cup/race_course/race_machine
are menu frames that need the fold applied to the reference or a region mask.
Every WAITMODE here CONTINUES on timeout, so a run whose log shows a timeout has shots
taken on the wrong screen. Check run.log before citing any BMP from this scenario.
